messages:
anya: quick heads-up: reproducible p99 latency spike on TP+fused-attn when seq ~2048. saw p99 jump ~42ms -> ~110ms on one shard. attaching profiler snapshot summary.
kevin: yikes. any all-gather backpressure in trace? :thinking_face: 
anya: trace shows QKV all-gather pausing ~50ms on GPU1, then kernel picker falls back from flash path to generic attn. flame shows nccl + memcpy dominated during stall; also noticed kvcache hit-rate dropped for those requests.
dmitri: could be picker choosing safe kernel because of qkv stride/align condition. flash-attn bails if leading dim misaligned or workspace budget exceeded.
anya: run log excerpt:
```
# env: tp=2, pp=1, bs=1, seq=2048
kernel_picker: selected=fused_attn_v2 score=0.44
flash_probe: alignment_fallthrough=true (qkv_stride=8208)
nccl_allgather: 49.8ms
kvcache_prefetch: blocked_wait=52ms
```
kevin: that qkv_stride=8208 is suspicious. with seq=2048 and FP32 QKV packing that lands on a bad boundary. we've seen similar where packing triggers fallback and kills overlap.
sara: can you reproduce reliably? maybe smaller micro-batches or extra padding changes picker behavior. If picker falls back it also changes batching heuristics and reduces concurrent allgathers, which worsens overlap.
anya: repro script: `./tools/run_infer.sh --tp 2 --model=mosaic --seq 2048 --profile` reproduces ~4/5 runs locally.
perf-ci-bot: perf-ci: benchmark queued 1953469999. baseline p99=42ms, candidate p99=108ms. artifacts: /ci/artifacts/1953469999/
kevin: two mitigation ideas:
- nudge picker: prefer flash kernel within a small qkv_stride delta and allow constrained workspace bump
- change prefetch: issue async kvcache prefetch/allgather earlier and try to overlap with the first compute chunk
dmitri: I prototyped an async-allgather shim that posts NCCL allgather, launches a tiny compute chunk, then waits. locally reduced the observed stall ~50ms -> ~12ms, at cost of ~3% extra SM work on prefetch path.
sara: paste shim pseudo?
dmitri: sure:
```
// pseudo-shim
post_async_allgather(qkv_shard, seq_token);
launch_small_compute_prefix(); // try to fill overlap window
wait_allgather();
merge_kv_into_cache();
```
kevin: nice. also update kernel picker state machine so fallback triggers a PROBE_ASYNC stage: PICK -> PROBE_ASYNC (start prefetch) -> LOCK_IN if probe succeeds or FALLBACK if not. reduces double-fallback thrash.
anya: any correctness concurrency risk with ordering and kvcache writes?
dmitri: we added a per-request seq token for prefetch writes to avoid stale merges; unit tests + kv-ordering tests pass locally. need integration tests.
sara: add telemetry: kernel_picker.fallback_count, async_prefetch.wait_us, qkv_stride histogram. that'll help correlate incidents.
perf-ci-bot: perf-ci: candidate 1953469999 results: p50=21ms (stable), p95=46ms (was 48), p99=46ms (improved from 108ms) 1 indicates async probe helped. full logs: /ci/artifacts/1953469999/log.txt
kevin: i'll roll a small canary on staging-dedicated (2 nodes) with async_prefetch flag and enhanced telemetry. monitor token-level latency and kvcache hit/miss plus kernel_picker metrics.
anya: scheduling canary for 2200 PT tonight, adding long-seq prompt set.
kevin: if canary looks stable, land runtime patch: 1) relax picker threshold, 2) gate async prefetch behind feature flag, 3) emit qkv_stride telemetry.
anya: filing a short PR description with perf artifacts link and test plan. thanks all. (cc @kevin @dmitri) :thumbsup:
